records.independent_review_status: Representative Flinders system/mainstem identity supported; whole-group scalar naming held.

limits: Regional generalized maps do not certify every headwater, anabranch, tributary reach or exact confluence.
Cloncurry, Corella, Dugald, Saxby, Bynoe and Armstrong names are distinctions, not aliases for the entire selected group.
The retained source and render sea endpoints differ by about 2.131527 km; neither is a surveyed mouth or contemporary coastline.

records.independent_review_status: Qualified representative Sarysu system identity supported; exact reach-name application held.
records.supported_name_scope: Regional east–west upper course, southwest bend and long southern lower valley agree with acquired full-basin thematic maps and written descriptions; separately named upstream components remain unresolved.
limits: The 761 km named-river convention begins at a confluence; a longer hydrological path can include Kairakty and Zhaman-Sarysu. Selected upstream name transitions are not established.
Floodwater reaches the Telekol/Telikol region episodically. The selected endorheic endpoint is not independently proven inside the named lake.
The 2017 page 158 is blank; only the 2013 publication provides usable full-basin map figures.
The two studies share authors and are not wholly independent naming authorities.

publication_contents: Own factual extraction and bounded review, complete ordered identifier citations, counts, hashes, bounded location facts and validators. No complete river coordinates, GeoJSON, binary packs or raw third-party documents/maps.
